description: 4D quantum Regge calculus, periodic Freudenthal-triangulated Z_L^4, I = lambda*sum V - k*sum delta*A, lambda=1, uniform measure prod dq_e, single-edge Metropolis (eps tuned to ~50% during thermalization, then frozen) plus, where nscale>0, nscale exact global-dilation MH moves per sweep (acceptance min(1, s^N_edges exp(-dI))). R = 2 sum delta*A / sum V per sweep. Errors from blocking (max over block sizes with >=16 blocks); 'plateau'=False means the blocking error had not converged (error likely underestimated). virial_ratio = <2 lambda sumV - k sumDA>/N_edges must equal 1 in equilibrium (exact scaling identity).
